sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
The project involves the end-to-end execution, system architecture, data processing, and validation protocols outlined in the uploaded project specification.

The objective is to establish a compliant, high-reliability operational baseline meeting all corporate engineering standards and client deliverables.

Key execution milestones target final operational sign-off by Q4 2025 across all primary subsystems.

sections.title: Project Scope
sections.content: Core engineering design, procurement of specialized hardware modules, cloud infrastructure provisioning, and integration testing across primary data pipelines.

sections.title: Key Deliverables
sections.content:
1. High-level architecture documentation and interface control documents.
2. Automated ETL and verification pipelines.
3. Complete test coverage reports and compliance sign-off certificates.

sections.title: Assumptions
sections.content: All network firewall rules, API credentials, and development environments are provisioned within Sprint 1. Stakeholder sign-offs occur within 5 business days.

sections.title: Constraints
sections.content: Data retention must comply with ISO 27001 policies. All core system services must operate with less than 200ms latency under peak load.

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.content: Legacy third-party system maintenance and off-cycle data reconciliation audits outside the agreed sprint boundaries.

sections.title: Milestones & Timeline
sections.content:
Sprint 1: Architecture Baseline & Ingestion Setup
Sprint 3: Pipeline Integration & Unit Test Completion
Sprint 5: End-to-End System Integration Testing
Sprint 6: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & Production Handover
